title: STYLE card frontmatter
description: Design-system token group — one card per group (colors, fonts, type scale, spacing, radius, shadows). Values are authored here so the viewer can render them; bind the card to the real CSS/config via code_refs or a connected FILE card so drift is caught by stale_report.

category.description: Which visual treatment the viewer uses. font = family specimens; color = swatch grid; type-scale = sized sample text; spacing = proportional bars; radius = rounded boxes; shadow = elevation chips; other = name/value table.

name.description: Token name, e.g. brand-blue, display, fs-body-md, spacing-md.

value.description: The CSS value: a color, a font-family stack, a size, a shadow, etc.

description.description: Usage note, e.g. 'Primary brand color — CTAs only'.

role.description: font only: Display Font / Body Font / Mono — the muted label above the specimen.

weights.description: font only: display string, e.g. 'Black (900)' or 'Regular (400) · Medium (500)'.

src.description: font only: repo-relative path to a woff2/woff/ttf/otf so the viewer renders the real font.

weight.description: type-scale only: CSS font-weight for the sample.

tokens.description: The tokens in this group, in display order.
